pages.text: The timer block starts a process again and again, at an interval you set.$(br2)Its dialog works like that of a trigger block, with one extra field: the interval in ticks. 20 ticks are one second. A new process only starts when the last one has ended.
A redstone signal pauses the timer block. Use a lever to switch it off and on. Like the trigger block, it can be camouflaged with any block in the camouflage slot.
Copper ingots in the corners, glass on the edges and a clock in the center give eight timer blocks.
Set a timer block to the function $(1)ring$() and an interval of 20 ticks. It plays a bell note every second. Put a lever next to it to stop the chime.

$(1)PROGRAM chime$(br)NOOP$(br)INCLUDE c0de/minecraft$(br)NOOP$(br)FUNCTION ring$(br)BEGIN$(br)  CALL c0de/minecraft/SOUND$(br)    PARAMETER note 12 ;$(br)    PARAMETER instrument "bell" ;$(br)END FUNCTION$()
